step2.description: To fix data, do not edit the generated files in /data/countries/. Instead, create or edit a file in /data/overrides/XX.json (where XX is the country code).

dataExport.title: Data Export
dataExport.description: Build custom locale-data exports with the /export wizard. No scrapers, no scripts, no signups.

dataset.title: 1. Pick a dataset
dataset.description: Choose Countries, Currencies, Languages, or Airports.

entities.title: 2. Select entities
entities.description: Searchable, paginated checkbox grid (60 per page) with select-all-filtered helpers. Up to 500 entities per request.

fields.title: 3. Choose fields
fields.description: Collapsible field tree generated from the dataset schema. Per-group indeterminate state, sensible defaults.

format.title: 4. Format & download
format.description: Pick JSON (pretty), JSON (minified), CSV (RFC 4180, flattened), or ZIP (one JSON file per entity).

items.csv: CSV — RFC 4180, dot-notation keys for nested fields
items.zip: ZIP — one JSON file per entity, ideal for batch processing

api.title: API Endpoint
api.description: Server-side serialization happens at POST /api/export (Node runtime, maxDuration: 30). Pass dataset, entities, fields, and format in the JSON body. Set preview: true for an inline first-record JSON response without Content-Disposition.
api.limits: Limits: max 500 entities per request, dataset must be one of countries / currencies / languages / airports.
